title: Survey of Trustworthy AI: A Meta Decision of AI

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conducts a systematic literature review (using the PRISMA methodology) to evaluate various algorithmic fairness frameworks and mitigation toolkits (such as AI Fairness 360). It reviews how these tools measure and address historical social biases (e.g., gender, ethnicity, sexuality, or disability) through mathematical definitions of fairness and debiasing algorithms at the pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing stages.
